bandReport.notes: Transcribed from the RIGHT (English) column. No General Knowledge heading on pages 15-22. Watermark checks against the Hindi column (p16): Q64 options 16 / 8 minutes, Q65 options 12 / 10 degC, Q67 options 1250 / 750 / 520 were partly covered by the serial-number watermark in the English column and match the Hindi column. Q65 prints 'Celcius' (sic), kept. Q69: the English option statement (D) says 'always complementary' but the Hindi (D) says sampurak (supplementary); English transcribed as printed, flagged. Q73 wording ('whose the measure') kept verbatim. Q80 option letters are printed with irregular spacing ('a bb a'); kept as printed. Q85 figure region uses the LEFT column's copy (the English copy has the serial watermark running beside it); its labels 'Pattern 1/2/3' are English in both copies. Other figures use the English copy, which has no serial watermark across it (Q68's Hindi copy has Hindi unit labels).
